name: camayoc_wf_declared_vs_traversed
description: workflow-and-archive Q5: the steps a workflow definition declares, against the ones a given run actually passed through. Composes the knowledge plane holding the definition with the operational window holding the run — the definition outlives the window and must not be frozen with it. A declared step the run never reached comes back with an EMPTY traversal time, which is the finding: a skipped step is absent from the transition log and must stay visibly absent rather than being filled in from the declaration.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?step ?stepLabel ?order ?traversedAt ?toState FROM <{definitions}> FROM <{window}> WHERE { <{definition}> aegis:hasStep ?step . ?step rdfs:label ?stepLabel ; aegis:stepOrder ?order . OPTIONAL { ?event a aegis:TransitionEvent ; aegis:inRun <{run}> ; aegis:atStep ?step ; aegis:observedAt ?traversedAt ; aegis:toState ?toState } } ORDER BY ?order

params.description: definitions parameter for this stored query.
